definitions.gloss: shift system; rotation system; shift work
definitions.explanation: A work schedule system where employees take turns working different time periods, ensuring continuous coverage. Common in factories, hospitals, and service industries.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}は{交代制|こうたいせい}で{稼働|かどう}している。
examples.english: This factory operates on a shift system.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}は{三|さん}{交代制|こうたいせい}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: The nurses work on a three-shift rotation.

examples.japanese: {交代制|こうたいせい}の{勤務|きんむ}は{生活|せいかつ}リズムが{崩|くず}れやすいのが{難点|なんてん}だ。
examples.english: The drawback of shift work is that it tends to disrupt your daily rhythm.

notes: Common types: {二|に}{交代制|こうたいせい} (two-shift system, typically day and night), {三|さん}{交代制|こうたいせい} (three-shift system, 8 hours each). Common collocations: {交代制|こうたいせい}{勤務|きんむ} (shift work), {交代制|こうたいせい}で{働|はたら}く (to work in shifts). The suffix ～{制|せい} indicates a system or structure: {会員制|かいいんせい} (membership system), {予約制|よやくせい} (reservation-only system). Related: シフト{制|せい} (shift system — using the English loanword), {当番制|とうばんせい} (duty rotation system).
